[{"name":"up_rebuy_recency_bucket","idea":"Pseudo-label rate learned at A-14d: among users who had last bought the product in the same days-since-last bucket (0-7, 7-14, 14-28, 28-56, 56+) as this user now, the share whose first order in the next 14 days contained it, smoothed toward the bucket-wide rate.","level":"pair","sql":"WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), fo AS (SELECT user_id, order_id FROM (SELECT user_id, order_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, order_id) AS rk FROM orders WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY) x WHERE rk = 1), fl AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.order_id, l.product_id FROM lines l JOIN fo ON l.order_id = fo.order_id), h AS (SELECT l.user_id, l.product_id, epoch((TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY) - max(l.ts)) / 86400.0 AS dd FROM lines l JOIN fo ON l.user_id = fo.user_id WHERE l.ts < TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY l.user_id, l.product_id), hb AS (SELECT h.product_id, CASE WHEN h.dd < 7 THEN 0 WHEN h.dd < 14 THEN 1 WHEN h.dd < 28 THEN 2 WHEN h.dd < 56 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS b, CASE WHEN fl.order_id IS NULL THEN 0.0 ELSE 1.0 END AS hit FROM h JOIN fo ON fo.user_id = h.user_id LEFT JOIN fl ON fl.order_id = fo.order_id AND fl.product_id = h.product_id), pb AS (SELECT product_id, b, count(*) AS n, sum(hit) AS k FROM hb GROUP BY product_id, b), bb AS (SELECT b, sum(k) / sum(n) AS pr FROM pb GROUP BY b), cur AS (SELECT l.user_id, l.product_id, epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - max(l.ts)) / 86400.0 AS dd FROM lines l JOIN cu ON l.user_id = cu.user_id GROUP BY l.user_id, l.product_id), cb AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, CASE WHEN dd < 7 THEN 0 WHEN dd < 14 THEN 1 WHEN dd < 28 THEN 2 WHEN dd < 56 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS b FROM cur) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, (COALESCE(pb.k, 0) + 20.0 * bb.pr) / (COALESCE(pb.n, 0) + 20.0) AS ag_pr_rebuy_bucket FROM cand c JOIN cb ON cb.user_id = c.user_id AND cb.product_id = c.product_id JOIN bb ON bb.b = cb.b LEFT JOIN pb ON pb.product_id = cb.product_id AND pb.b = cb.b;"},
{"name":"p_pseudo_adopt_rebuy14","idea":"Pseudo-label rates at A-14d over users with prior history: the share of prior non-buyers whose first order in the last 14 days adopted the product, and the smoothed share of prior buyers whose first order rebought it.","level":"item","sql":"WITH fo AS (SELECT user_id, order_id FROM (SELECT user_id, order_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, order_id) AS rk FROM orders WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY) x WHERE rk = 1), pu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM orders WHERE ts < TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY), co AS (SELECT fo.user_id, fo.order_id FROM fo JOIN pu ON fo.user_id = pu.user_id), nc AS (SELECT count(*) AS n_co FROM co), pv AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.user_id, l.product_id FROM lines l JOIN co ON l.user_id = co.user_id WHERE l.ts < TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY), fl AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.user_id, l.product_id FROM lines l JOIN co ON l.order_id = co.order_id), pp AS (SELECT product_id, count(*) AS n_prev FROM pv GROUP BY product_id), fa AS (SELECT fl.product_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE pv.user_id IS NULL) AS n_adopt, count(pv.user_id) AS n_rebuy FROM fl LEFT JOIN pv ON pv.user_id = fl.user_id AND pv.product_id = fl.product_id GROUP BY fl.product_id) SELECT COALESCE(pp.product_id, fa.product_id) AS product_id, (COALESCE(fa.n_adopt, 0) + 0.1) / (nc.n_co - COALESCE(pp.n_prev, 0) + 100.0) * 1000.0 AS ag_p_adopt14, (COALESCE(fa.n_rebuy, 0) + 1.0) / (COALESCE(pp.n_prev, 0) + 5.0) AS ag_p_rebuy14 FROM pp FULL OUTER JOIN fa ON pp.product_id = fa.product_id CROSS JOIN nc;"},
{"name":"uc_rebuy_recency_bucket","idea":"Category-level pseudo-label rate at A-14d: share of users with the same days-since-last-category-purchase bucket (or never bought the category) whose first order in the next 14 days contained the category, applied to every candidate via the user's current bucket.","level":"pair","sql":"WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), fo AS (SELECT user_id, order_id FROM (SELECT user_id, order_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, order_id) AS rk FROM orders WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY) x WHERE rk = 1), pu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM orders WHERE ts < TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY), co AS (SELECT fo.user_id, fo.order_id FROM fo JOIN pu ON fo.user_id = pu.user_id), nc AS (SELECT count(*) AS n_co FROM co), hc AS (SELECT l.user_id, l.master_category_id AS cat, epoch((TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY) - max(l.ts)) / 86400.0 AS dd FROM lines l JOIN co ON l.user_id = co.user_id WHERE l.ts < TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND l.master_category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.user_id, l.master_category_id), fc AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.user_id, l.master_category_id AS cat FROM lines l JOIN co ON l.order_id = co.order_id WHERE l.master_category_id IS NOT NULL), hh AS (SELECT hc.cat, CASE WHEN hc.dd < 7 THEN 0 WHEN hc.dd < 14 THEN 1 WHEN hc.dd < 28 THEN 2 WHEN hc.dd < 56 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS b, CASE WHEN fc.user_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS hit FROM hc LEFT JOIN fc ON fc.user_id = hc.user_id AND fc.cat = hc.cat), hb AS (SELECT cat, b, count(*) AS n, sum(hit) AS k FROM hh GROUP BY cat, b), ft AS (SELECT cat, count(*) AS k_all FROM fc GROUP BY cat), hn AS (SELECT cat, sum(n) AS n_h, sum(k) AS k_h FROM hb GROUP BY cat), nv AS (SELECT COALESCE(hn.cat, ft.cat) AS cat, 5 AS b, nc.n_co - COALESCE(hn.n_h, 0) AS n, COALESCE(ft.k_all, 0) - COALESCE(hn.k_h, 0) AS k FROM hn FULL OUTER JOIN ft ON hn.cat = ft.cat CROSS JOIN nc), rt AS (SELECT cat, b, n, k FROM hb UNION ALL SELECT cat, b, n, k FROM nv), pc AS (SELECT product_id, max(master_category_id) AS cat FROM lines WHERE master_category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id), uc AS (SELECT l.user_id, l.master_category_id AS cat, epoch(TIMESTAMP '{A}' - max(l.ts)) / 86400.0 AS dd FROM lines l JOIN cu ON l.user_id = cu.user_id WHERE l.master_category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.user_id, l.master_category_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, (COALESCE(rt.k, 0) + 1.0) / (COALESCE(rt.n, 0) + 2.0) AS ag_uc_rebuy_bucket FROM cand c JOIN pc ON pc.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN uc ON uc.user_id = c.user_id AND uc.cat = pc.cat LEFT JOIN rt ON rt.cat = pc.cat AND rt.b = CASE WHEN uc.dd IS NULL THEN 5 WHEN uc.dd < 7 THEN 0 WHEN uc.dd < 14 THEN 1 WHEN uc.dd < 28 THEN 2 WHEN uc.dd < 56 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END;"},
{"name":"up_category_switch_after","idea":"For products the user bought: number of the user's orders with the product's category placed after the last purchase of the product and the number of distinct other products of that category bought since (evidence of switching to a substitute).","level":"pair","sql":"WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), pc AS (SELECT product_id, max(master_category_id) AS cat FROM lines WHERE master_category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id), ul AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.user_id, l.order_id, l.ts, l.product_id, l.master_category_id AS cat FROM lines l JOIN cu ON l.user_id = cu.user_id), up AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, max(ts) AS last_ts FROM ul GROUP BY user_id, product_id), cp AS (SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, pc.cat, up.last_ts FROM cand c JOIN up ON up.user_id = c.user_id AND up.product_id = c.product_id JOIN pc ON pc.product_id = c.product_id) SELECT cp.user_id, cp.product_id, count(DISTINCT ul.order_id) AS ag_uc_orders_after, count(DISTINCT ul.product_id) AS ag_uc_subs_after FROM cp LEFT JOIN ul ON ul.user_id = cp.user_id AND ul.cat = cp.cat AND ul.ts > cp.last_ts GROUP BY cp.user_id, cp.product_id;"},
{"name":"up_price_now_vs_paid","idea":"Log ratio of the product's current 7-day median price at the user's main retailer (global 7-day median as fallback) to the price the user paid at the last purchase, capturing price drops or hikes on repeat items.","level":"pair","sql":"WITH cu AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM cand), um AS (SELECT user_id, retailer FROM (SELECT o.user_id, o.retailer, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY o.user_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC, max(o.ts) DESC, o.retailer) AS rk FROM orders o JOIN cu ON o.user_id = cu.user_id GROUP BY o.user_id, o.retailer) x WHERE rk = 1), lp AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, price FROM (SELECT l.user_id, l.product_id, l.price, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY l.user_id, l.product_id ORDER BY l.ts DESC, l.order_id DESC, l.line_item_id DESC) AS rk FROM lines l JOIN cu ON l.user_id = cu.user_id) y WHERE rk = 1 AND price > 0), rp AS (SELECT o.retailer, l.product_id, median(l.price) AS mp FROM lines l JOIN orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id WHERE l.ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND o.retailer IN (SELECT retailer FROM um) GROUP BY o.retailer, l.product_id), gp AS (SELECT product_id, median(price) AS mp FROM lines WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '{A}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY product_id) SELECT c.user_id, c.product_id, ln(COALESCE(rp.mp, gp.mp) / lp.price) AS ag_up_price_now_rel FROM cand c JOIN lp ON lp.user_id = c.user_id AND lp.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN um ON um.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN rp ON rp.retailer = um.retailer AND rp.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN gp ON gp.product_id = c.product_id;"}]
